corrections.recordedError: Build totals differ from the priced audit.
corrections.finding: False failure: Pilot and Production shared the same display name. The checker matched both build rows to the first audit entry. The actual report correctly priced Pilot at $0.00 and Production at $2.40.
corrections.fix: Match each build row to a distinct audit entry by name, scenario identity, phase and purchasing label.
corrections.verification: The original saved spec, audit, HTML, engine build output and final answer pass the corrected artifact grader. No new conversation or overwritten result.

confirmationObservations.interpretation: These are observations of recorded engine errors, not independent root-cause verdicts. The strict engine can reject framing around an otherwise complete readback or an intervening assistant message. The runner's eventual missing-readback or timeout label does not prove that the model omitted the readback or produced an incorrect price.

limitations: Original automatic scores and raw results remain unchanged; the single correction is reported separately.
Scores measure this bounded workflow with its strict confirmation contract, four-minute deadline and eight-customer-turn limit. They are not general model-quality or unrestricted-shell ratings.
The remaining 83 flags are not 83 demonstrated pricing errors and do not automatically block those models.
Changing the artifact grader changes the suite signature; future conversation runs must start a new result set.
